critique: FAIL: 1. **Critical Text Overflow/Clipping on Right Side**: The Core Contribution card at `<rect x='900' y='440' width='320' height='145'>` has text that extends beyond its right boundary. The text lines with `x='920'` and font-size='20' are too long for the 320px width container (920+280=1200 > 900+320=1220, but actual text width exceeds). The text 'A new simple network architecture,' and subsequent lines are visually truncated/clipped at the right edge of the blue card. **Fix**: Increase card width to `width='380'` or reduce font-size to `font-size='16'` on all four `<text>` elements at y='475', '505', '535', '565'. 2. **Authors and Affiliations Text Overflow**: The authors text at `<text x='900' y='215'>` and affiliations at `<text x='900' y='310'>` extend far beyond the right edge of the slide (1280px canvas). With x='900' and long content, these text elements overflow the 1280px boundary. **Fix**: Wrap authors into two lines with shorter width by changing x to `x='700'` and adding `text-anchor='start'`, or reduce font-size to `font-size='18'` and set `width='300'` with text wrapping. 3. **Conference Text Overflow**: The conference text at `<text x='900' y='385'>` also exceeds canvas width. **Fix**: Move to `x='700'` or reduce to `font-size='14'`. 4. **Insufficient Contrast on White Background**: The authors, affiliations, and conference text use `#FFFFFF` and `#E2E8F0` colors but are positioned over the white background area (the parallelogram white layer at x>460), making them nearly invisible. **Fix**: Change text fill colors to `#1A1A1A` or `#0A3D8F` for all text elements currently using white/light colors that are not over the blue parallelogram. Specifically: change `<text x='900' y='215' fill='#FFFFFF'>` to `fill='#1A1A1A'`, `<text x='900' y='255' fill='#FFFFFF'>` to `fill='#1A1A1A'`, `<text x='900' y='310' fill='#E2E8F0'>` to `fill='#4A5568'`, `<text x='900' y='340' fill='#E2E8F0'>` to `fill='#4A5568'`, and `<text x='900' y='385' fill='#E2E8F0'>` to `fill='#4A5568'`.
